propositions: Detached pytest runs report test errors that do not reproduce in foreground runs, but detachment itself is not the cause—external concurrent mutations of the shared checkout are.
The _no_repo_root_leaks guard misattributes external concurrent file writes to the test that happened to execute during that write, and silently deletes those files.
Browser e2e harness failures from signal-killed child processes report empty stderr with no returncode inspection, masking the actual cause (SIGKILL) as a product failure.

Detached suite runs are trustworthy provided the checkout is not mutated concurrently; documentation and diagnostics must clearly name the external-actor mechanism rather than suppressing detached-run warnings.

The leak guard message must clarify that entries may come from concurrent external processes outside the test, and the e2e browser diagnostic must include proc.returncode to distinguish signal-killed children from real failures.
